caption: A ripe apple comes loose from a branch and drops through the leaves to the grass beneath the tree.

sa.check: An apple hangs from a branch.
It lands on the grass beneath.
The loosening comes first, then the drop, then the landing.

pc.expect: It falls straight down, speeding up, and comes to rest below the branch.
pc.fail: It drifts sideways; or pauses; or rises.

pc.expect: It brushes through the leaves without stopping.
pc.fail: It stops in the leaves; or bounces up high; or reverses.

pc.expect: The leaves stir as it passes.
pc.fail: They stay rigid; or stir before; or the apple passes through them untouched.

pc.expect: The apple is firm and may bounce low.
pc.fail: It splashes; or bounces high; or floats.
It duplicates; or vanishes; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The apple's colour and the tree stay the same.
pc.fail: The apple changes colour; or the tree rearranges; or the grass changes.
